title: Two-Ball Control Challenge
description: Players dribble two balls at once from a stationary position, a demanding coordination challenge that builds control well beyond what one ball requires.

content.objective: Control two balls bouncing at once without either one escaping.
content.setup: Each player has two balls and sits with open space on both sides.
instructions: Dribble both balls at the same height and the same time for 15 touches.
Alternate the balls so one is up while the other is down for 15 touches.
Dribble both low and close to the chair for 15 seconds.
Rest and repeat for two more sets.
coachingPoints: Keep both balls at a consistent, controlled height.
Stay relaxed through the shoulders rather than tensing up.
Reset calmly if a ball escapes instead of rushing to grab it.
commonMistakes: Letting one ball drift higher or further out than the other.
Chasing an escaped ball into another player's space.
Letting the off-hand drop instead of staying ready to protect the ball.
content.safety: Leave enough room around each player for a ball that gets away.
